# f5xc_dns_load_balancer (Resource)

DNS Load Balancer Record is used for configuring DNS Load Balancer for a record.

To get more information about f5xc_dns_load_balancer, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/dns-load-balancer)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Dns Load Balancer - Full

resource "f5xc_dns_lb_pool" "test_pool" {
  name      = "example-dnslbpool-full-c53lww-52000"
  namespace = "system"

  load_balancing_mode = ["ROUND_ROBIN"]
  pool_type_choice = {
    a_pool = {
      health_check_choice = {
        disable_health_check = true
      }
      members = [
        {
          ip_endpoint = "1.2.3.4"
          name        = "member-1"
          priority    = 1
          ratio       = 1
        }
      ]
    }
  }
  ttl_choice = {
    ttl = 30
  }
}

resource "f5xc_dns_load_balancer" "example" {
  name        = "example-dnslb-full-c53lww-42000"
  namespace   = "system"
  description = "Full acceptance test DNS load balancer"

  labels = {
    "env"  = "example"
    "tier" = "dns"
  }

  record_type = ["A"]

  fallback_pool = {
    name      = f5xc_dns_lb_pool.test_pool.name
    namespace = "system"
    tenant    = "customer1"
  }

  response_cache = {
    response_cache_parameters_choice = {
      response_cache_parameters = {
        cache_cidr_ipv4 = 24
        cache_cidr_ipv6 = 56
        cache_ttl       = 3600
      }
    }
  }

  rule_list = {
    rules = [
      {
        action_choice = {
          pool = {
            name      = f5xc_dns_lb_pool.test_pool.name
            namespace = "system"
            tenant    = "customer1"
          }
        }
        client_choice = {
          asn_list = {
            as_numbers = [64512]
          }
        }
        score = 200
      },
      {
        action_choice = {
          pool = {
            name      = f5xc_dns_lb_pool.test_pool.name
            namespace = "system"
            tenant    = "customer1"
          }
        }
        client_choice = {
          ip_prefix_list = {
            ip_prefixes = ["10.0.0.0/8"]
          }
        }
        score = 100
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''
- `record_type` (List of String) Resource Record Type<br>**Allowed Values (choose one):** `['A', 'AAAA', 'CNAME', 'MX', 'SRV']`

- `description` (String) description Human readable description for the object
- `fallback_pool` (Attributes) fallback pool Fallback Pool to be used for load balancing if none of the Load Balancing rules match (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--fallback_pool))
- `labels` (Map of String) labels Map of string keys and values that can be used to organize and categorize (scope and select) objects as chosen by the user. Values specified here will be used by selector expression
- `response_cache` (Attributes) Response Cache Parameters Response Cache Parameters (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--response_cache))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `dns_zones` (Attributes List) backref_objs a list of DNS Zones associated with this load balancer (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--dns_zones))

### Nested Schema for `rule_list.rules`

Required:

- `action_choice` (Attributes) action choice Action for the DNS Load Balancing Rule<br>`pool` must be specified. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rule_list--rules--action_choice))
- `client_choice` (Attributes) client_choice Selects the clients for which the DNS Load Balancing Rule will be applied. The conditions are limited to the geo location, ASN, and IP prefix from where the client DNS request originates. This geo location, ASN, and IP prefix is derived from the EDNS0 client subnet.<br>Exactly one of `asn_list`, `asn_matcher`, `geo_location_label_selector`, `geo_location_set`, `ip_prefix_list`, or `ip_prefix_set` must be specified.
